info.description: CONTRACT DRAFT ONLY. These routes are target interfaces, not a running HTTP server. Existing repository components are local research prototypes and simulated adapters. Live identity registries, MINAH model services, authoritative rule sources, payment providers, distributed messaging, cryptographic verification and Nexus Pod hardware are not connected by this document.

bearerAuth.description: Target auth mechanism only. Issuer, audience, algorithms, key rotation, token profile and revocation semantics remain implementation decisions.

x-critical-production-gates: Define and implement authentication, authorisation, service-to-service identity, key rotation and revocation.
Define canonical error codes, idempotency persistence, retry windows, request size limits, pagination and rate limits.
Specify wire schemas and compatibility policy; generate SDKs only after contract review.
Connect MINAH only behind the jurisprudential disposition contract, with approved jurisdictional sources, evaluation, human escalation and model/version governance.
Connect financial providers through provider-specific adapters and independently verified callbacks/webhooks; no API route implies settlement finality.
Specify authority federation, message signing, delivery guarantees, distributed state/consensus model and recovery semantics.
Define evidence storage, classification, retention, legal hold, encryption and data-subject/access controls.
Define Nexus Pod hardware and firmware interfaces separately; never treat a node's health response as proof of hardware integrity.
Run contract, integration, adversarial, load, resilience, security and deployment-profile acceptance suites before production.
